axisReviews.evidence: Racial equality, migrant farmworkers and attention to Native American deprivation favour inclusive citizenship.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: His appeals to national unity qualify a preference for group identities overriding every common civic obligation.

axisReviews.evidence: Criticism of discrimination and attention to migrant workers favour broader access and humane protection.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Domestic farmworker advocacy does not settle national visa ceilings or every irregular-entry rule; those mechanisms are contextual estimates.

axisReviews.evidence: His 1968 Landon lecture rejects further Vietnam escalation and seeks meaningful negotiations.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Earlier involvement in Cuba and Vietnam decisions and opposition to surrender show he was not an unconditional pacifist.

axisReviews.evidence: Consultation with allies and international responsibility qualify unilateral national action.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Negotiated internationalism does not establish surrender of currency or accession to a world political federation.

axisReviews.evidence: Community development and public action against poverty coexist with private enterprise and investment.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Bedford-Stuyvesant sought partnerships with business; this is not wholesale nationalisation or evidence for a public national broadcaster.

axisReviews.evidence: Economic opportunity and development were stressed in an internationally connected market economy.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: No complete tariff doctrine was found; concern for workers tempers unrestricted import competition without asserting isolationism.

axisReviews.evidence: Anti-poverty investment, labour protection and community programmes coexist with private economic initiative.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Community participation differs from compulsory national production schedules; free private currency is an unsupported extension.

axisReviews.evidence: His later programme treats deprivation and unequal opportunity as requiring material public action.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: He favoured jobs and community development rather than only unconditional transfers; a basic safety net can coexist with substantial redistribution.

axisReviews.evidence: Civil law, anti-discrimination and religious liberty coexist with Catholic moral language.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Personal Catholic devotion does not establish church approval of legislation or national religious family courts.

axisReviews.evidence: Racial and gender equality arguments coexist with family-centred moral conventions in the 1960s.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: No developed programme on today’s same-sex adoption or gender-identity curriculum was located; mixed answers reflect equality with period-specific family norms.

axisReviews.evidence: His Kansas speech criticises pollution and destruction while seeking development that meets human needs.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Concern for environment is not rejection of infrastructure; untested biological enhancement receives cautious historical extrapolation.

axisReviews.evidence: Federal enforcement of civil rights coexists with neighbourhood-led development and Native American community concerns.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: His civil-rights enforcement distinguishes enforcing constitutional rights from federal operation of all local schools.

axisReviews.evidence: His poverty and community arguments foreground deprivation, education and discrimination as causes of social outcomes.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: These are social explanations, not a claim that biology plays no role in stress, temperament or attention.

neutralReview.rationale: Educated assumption: Civil-rights enforcement and electoral campaigning support equal political participation under constitutional law. Applying that record to the exact claim “Voters should be able to repeal a law through a binding referendum.”, Neutral is a substantive mixed/conditional judgement on binding popular repeal: the supported commitments above pull in different directions when applied to this specific mechanism. It is not a missing-evidence placeholder. His enforcement record and earlier anti-communist work require scrutiny, rather than using later reform rhetoric to erase them. The sources support the context, not a personal answer to this questionnaire; the precise strength and any contemporary institutional translation remain uncertain. Neutral-specific review: Popular participation supports a referendum mechanism, while representative legislative responsibility weighs against an unconditional national repeal power.
